adjudication.rationale: The diff does show two access patterns in `admin-group.js.es6` (computed props call `this.get("offset"/"limit"/"user_count")`, while `next`/`previous` use `var group = this.get("model")` and then `group.get(...)`). But nothing in the diff demonstrates this causes incorrect behavior: this controller is an `Em.ObjectController`, which is designed to proxy model/content properties onto the controller (and the templates also rely on that proxying by referencing `{{user_count}}`, `{{members}}`, etc. directly). So the finding is essentially a consistency/style nit, not a verifiable defect or substantive review issue grounded in the diff.
